activity.notes: Marie and Pierre Curie's Paris research in 1898 produced the announcements of polonium and radium. ATLAS records 1898 as a precisely documented representative scientific Activity in the French Republic rather than using Marie Curie's full lifespan or nationality changes as a proxy for research activity.

sources.title: Marie and Pierre Curie and the discovery of polonium and radium — Nobel Prize
sources.citation_text: Nobel Prize materials document the Curie's 1898 announcements of polonium and radium in Paris.
